column1: # Expected values for the 18 reverse-greedy sets, taken from the table of an earlier run of the same tool
# (command: rgreedy rev N --cmax 6.5 --dump rev_N.txt).  check_sets.py compares sets/rev_N.txt with columns n, k, fnv1a64.
# fnv1a64 = 64-bit FNV-1a of the decimal text "a_1,a_2,...,a_k" (offset basis 0xcbf29ce484222325, prime 0x100000001b3).
# table_bits and time_s are informational (hash-table size 2^table_bits and tool wall time in seconds of that earlier run);
# the n = 20000000 row of the earlier run used table_bits 29, the default of the current source is 30 (see README.md).
